svg.title: Cyella — full logo
svg.desc: The Stella emblem at left and the Cyella calligraphy at right, optically aligned with a clear gap between the two botanical ornaments. Approved universal-color Stella icon and connected Gothic calligraphy with a sweeping antique-gold flourish. Transparent background. All artwork is self-contained vector geometry; no fonts, raster images, gradients, scripts or external resources. Lettering follows currentColor; the icon and gold ornament retain their fixed colors.
